alt.sh: Alt text for the asset (default language).

asset_folder_id.sh: Id of the folder that contains this asset.

filename.sh: Full path of the asset, including the file name.

is_private.sh: Defines if the asset should be inaccessible to the public.

signed_url.sh: The signed URL for the asset.

dimensions.sh: An array listing the dimensions defined for the data source.

name.sh: Internal name (lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores).

story_ids.sh: IDs of [stories](https://www.storyblok.com/docs/api/content-delivery/v2/stories/the-story-object) assigned to the experiment.

alternates.sh: An array that contains objects correlating to the language versions defined using [field-level translation](https://www.storyblok.com/docs/concepts/internationalization#field-level-translation).

is_folder.sh: Returns `true` if the item is a folder.

is_startpage.sh: Returns `true` if the story is the folder’s root.

path.sh: Real path defined in the story’s entry configuration.

position.sh: Numeric representation of the story’s position in the folder.

published.sh: Returns `true` if the story is currently published.

real_path.sh: Either the full slug of the story or folder with a leading `/`, or the value of the real path defined in the story’s entry configuration with a leading `/`.

domain.sh: Domain associated with the space (configured under **Visual Editor** → **Location**).

language_codes.sh: An array of language codes configured in the space.

link_uuids.sh: An array of all linked stories’ UUIDs.

rel_uuids.sh: An array of all referenced stories’ UUIDs.

tag_on_stories.sh: The number of distinct stories this tag appears on (only present when all_tags parameter is true).

taggings_count.sh: The number of stories that include this tag.

associated_content.sh: An array of story objects associated with the taxonomy.

last_author.sh: An object that contains the details of user who created the term.

taxonomy.sh: An object that contains a taxonomy.

taxonomy_term.sh: An object that contains a taxonomy.
